_about: Hand classification for scripts/ui_coverage.py: backend items the client does not reference directly. [status, note]. status: surfaced | partial | missing | plumbing | legacy. Regenerate UI_COVERAGE.md with: python3 scripts/ui_coverage.py --write

GET /api/_admin/security-stats: operator token only; not a user feature
GET /api/_admin/analytics: operator token only; the owner's /admin page reads /api/admin/site-report instead
GET /api/data/aircraft/estimate/:hex: Server-side position ESTIMATE for a plane that stopped reporting. Built for the mobile app (contract section 8). CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the web card estimates the selected plane in the browser with the same arithmetic (shared/aircraftEstimate.ts through client/src/lib/air/planeMotion.ts) and marks it an estimate. It does not ask the server, so a watched plane that is not selected gets no estimate.
GET /api/data/aircraft/fleet: Past flights for saved tail numbers. Built for the mobile app (docs/aircraft_app_data_contract.md, section 4). CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the web flight card lists the same flight objects for one plane through /api/data/aircraft/trips/:hex. What the web lacks is the all-saved-tails view in one answer. Whether the app shows it cannot be checked from this repository.
POST /api/auth/reset-request: Legacy stub that tells callers to use /api/auth/reset (which the login page uses). Removal candidate; auth.ts is a FROZEN PATH, so the human removes it.
GET /api/billing/status: Billing is not switched on (MONETIZATION TRIPWIRE); no account page reads it yet. Becomes user-relevant the day billing is enabled.
POST /api/admin/users/:email/tier: operator action; billing.ts is a FROZEN PATH
GET /api/bot/stream: Live event stream (SSE) of the bot's actions. No page listens to it: the AI Engine page polls. Placement: feed the existing activity log on the AI Engine page from the stream so it updates without a refresh.
GET /api/bot/history: The last 50 closed orders from the broker. Superseded 2026-11-20 by /api/bot/order-history (every status, the price ladder's steps), which the Orders panel reads, and by /api/bot/lots for closed trades. Nothing reads this one. Removal candidate.
GET /api/system/health-check: operator diagnostics; /api/health is the public form
POST /api/bot/circuit-breaker/reset: Owner action: clear a tripped circuit breaker. The AI Engine page shows the kill state but offers no reset. Placement: beside the kill-state banner, owner only, with a confirm step. A risk control: needs the human's go-ahead before it is exposed.
GET /api/diag/:probe: token-gated diagnostics for sessions; each probe is listed below
POST /api/bot/trade: Owner manual order. No UI. The execution-layer spec routes every order through one path; expose only after that decision (owner).
POST /api/bot/close: Owner manual close of a position. No UI. Placement: a 'Close' action on a Book row, owner only, with a confirm step. Same owner decision as the row above.
GET /api/monitoring/overview: Pre-refocus monitoring summary (daemon, kill switch, drawdown, model). Checked against the AI Engine page 2026-11-20: its kill-switch block (the daemon's risk_status, get_kill_switch_status) takes the losing streak and the day's loss from two files nothing writes, so both always read 0; the page reads the real figures through /api/bot/safety-limits, the model through /api/ml/status and the drawdown through /api/bot/status. Nothing to surface. Removal is its own PR (drawdownGuard.test.ts pins its text).
GET /api/monitoring/tier-pnl: P&L by strategy bucket from the trade-feedback file. It adds per-trade percentages whatever the size of each trade, so the total cannot be read as money. The page shows P&L per sleeve in dollars from the broker's own fills (the sleeve ledger, the expectancy table). Nothing to surface.
GET /api/monitoring/drawdown: Drawdown from the engine's shared peak, with -20 written into the route. /api/bot/safety-limits (2026-11-20) measures each drawdown guard from its own peak against its own limit, on the page. Nothing to surface. Removal is its own PR (peakEquityRpc.test.ts pins its text).
POST /api/bot/backtest: runs the backtest CLI from the server; no page calls it. Removal candidate (STALENESS AUDIT).
POST /api/bot/run-now: Owner action: run a scan now. Placement: a button beside 'last scan' on the AI Engine page, owner only.
GET /api/bot/ml-status: duplicate of /api/ml/status, which the page reads. Removal candidate.
GET /api/data/aircraft/plan-status: flight-plan pipeline status; belongs in Pipeline health if anywhere
GET /api/data/aircraft/intent-coverage: coverage counters for the intent join
GET /api/data/aircraft/global_scopes: internal scope list for the world feed
GET /api/data/3dtiles/status: 3D tiles proxy status (key-gated provider, not enabled)
GET /api/data/query: The query engine (console W4). The analyst pane uses it on the server; there is no direct query box. Placement: none proposed until the analyst pane's use shows a need.
GET /api/data/satellites: Server-side satellite catalog (relay-gated: CelesTrak blocks Railway). The map reads CelesTrak from the browser instead. Nothing to place until the relay decision.
GET /api/debug/finnhub-insider/:ticker: debug route for one data provider
GET /api/bot/system-status: pre-refocus status route; the page reads /api/bot/status. Removal candidate.
GET /api/market-snapshot: pre-refocus route; no page reads it. Removal candidate.
GET /api/trades/today: pre-refocus route. Removal candidate (its content belongs to the closed-trades table above).
GET /api/positions: pre-refocus route; the Book reads /api/bot/positions. Removal candidate.
GET /api/shorts/dashboard: pre-refocus route; no page reads it. Removal candidate.
POST /api/ml/retrain: operator action; retrain runs on schedule
GET /api/data/swim/tfms/active: Active FAA traffic-management initiatives (ground stops, delay programs). No UI. Placement: on the existing FAA airport status layer's cards.
GET /api/data/swim/notam/tfrs: Temporary flight restrictions from SWIM NOTAMs. No UI. Placement: a toggleable map layer in the aviation group (symbol per TFR kind, legend entry).
GET /api/legal/terms: terms text; the marketing pages carry their own copy
GET /api/news: Polygon news passthrough from before the refocus. No page reads it: the News tab reads /api/market/news. It was counted as called by a page until 2026-11-20 because /api/newsletter starts the same way. Removal candidate.
GET /api/data/aircraft/track/:hex: A plane's flown track with altitude, speed and vertical rate at each point. Built for the mobile app (contract section 3). CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the web draws a plane's track from the older /api/data/track route. Not shown on the web: this route's per-point vertical rate, which altitude each point is, and its list of coverage gaps.

lots: Closed-lot ledger. Since 2026-11-20 the Book's 'Closed trades' table and its CSV read the same rows through the owner route /api/bot/lots.
option_bars: session-only price lookup for up to 10 contracts
benchmark: Overview: account vs SPY, after tax
regime_counterfactual: What the regime engine changed versus the old rule (counts, no P&L). Since 2026-11-20 a line in the Why panel's regime section, through /api/bot/regime-counterfactual.
floor_tracking: The base holding against its own rule. Since 2026-11-20 the Why panel's 'Base holding' section shows the sentence, the per-session table, the rollback line and turnover, through /api/bot/floor-tracking.
orders: Open and recent orders. Since 2026-11-20 the Orders panel's 'Order history' lists every order with its price-ladder step, through the owner route /api/bot/order-history.
archive: Archive health per stream. Since 2026-11-20 the Data quality panel lists every archive's files, size, first and newest file (/api/data/archive/stats) and the off-site copy (/api/data/archive/offload-status). What this probe reports beyond those two routes has not been compared field by field; do that before placing anything more.
shadow: Would-be entries from the 2026-10-28..11-04 shadow period and how they did. No UI. Placement: a closed section on the Overview once labelled; low priority.
ml_v3: The candidate model's out-of-sample readings. CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the Brain page's 'ML v3 candidate' card shows them (brain_evidence.py reads the same status: out-of-sample AUC with its confidence interval, log-loss against the base rate, top-minus-bottom quintile, rows and dates, and the IC of its logged probability on the live shadow population). Not shown: the calibration deciles and the per-regime split.
shadow_bands: The same score-band table WITHOUT de-duplication. Kept for comparison only: each candidate was logged about 30 times a day, and reading this version is what produced the October 'the score is anti-predictive' artifact. It should not be shown; the de-duplicated probe is the honest one.
shadow_bands_dedup: Score-band outcomes from the shadow log, one first-seen record per ticker per day. CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the Brain page's short-term evidence is computed under this same de-duplication rule (decision buckets against SPY, the score's own IC). What no page shows is this probe's table of outcomes by score quintile and by day-change band. Placement if wanted: a small table on the Brain page's 'Minimum score gate' card.
source_validation: Per-source validation of the scoring inputs. CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'missing'): the Brain page shows it (brain_evidence.py trims source_validation.py's own report): each input's short-term rank IC, its confidence interval, Benjamini-Hochberg q and verdict on its card, and the forward selection and ablation in the 'combinations' panel.
shadowfleet_gate1: gate result; the Signal strength panel shows each root's ladder position, not the gate's numbers. Placement: expandable evidence row in Signal strength.
lazy_prices: as above (backfill progress and gate reading)
chain_iv30: Option-chain archive readings. The Trade page shows a live IV figure; the archive's history is not shown. Placement: Trade page IV chart, once the archive has enough days.
options_entitlements: Which options data the account is entitled to. Since 2026-11-20 the Book says which QUOTE feed applies (indicative today) under its options, through /api/bot/options-feed. The rest of the report (historical trades, bars, open interest per vendor) has no UI; it is an execution-layer Phase 0 fact.
kill_state: kill-state banner; since 2026-11-20 each guard's reading, peak and limit in the Issues panel's Safety limits block (through /api/bot/safety-limits)
gate_counterfactuals: What each blocking rule prevented. Since 2026-11-20 the Why panel's 'Rules that blocked trades' section shows one row per rule, tier and action with its caveats, through /api/bot/rule-counterfactuals.
walkforward: The multi-year walk-forward test of the score's price inputs. CORRECTED 2026-11-20 (was 'partial'): the Brain page shows each input's long-term verdict from it (brain_evidence.py reads the last good result) beside the short-term evidence, with the run's date; the AI Engine's 'why' card also cites it in words.
form4_completeness: Per-day completeness of the Form 4 archive. The 13F page shows completeness by filed day (#1845); Form 4's page does not yet. Placement: the same header on the Form 4 page.
filings13f_completeness: 13F page, by filed day (#1845, API); the page itself still reads by archive day: PARTIAL in the UI
edgar_poll: EDGAR poller failures. Placement: Pipeline health.
heartbeats: Every scheduled job: ok, late, missing, errored. No UI; /api/health carries a summary. Placement: a 'Jobs' section in the /data Pipeline health panel.
squeeze_gex: Dealer-gamma readings. The Analyze page shows a GEX figure; the condor filter's decisions are in the decision journal. Placement: none further.
gamma: as above (dealer-gamma readings; the Analyze page shows a GEX figure)

strategies/momentum.py: scoring module; its results show under its sleeve in expectancy-by-sleeve, not by strategy name
strategies/mean_reversion.py: as above: results show under its sleeve, not by strategy name
strategies/squeeze.py: as above: results show under its sleeve, not by strategy name
volatility-managed base (floor_vol_manag: The largest holding. Since 2026-11-20 the Why panel's 'Base holding' section shows it against its own rule (see floor_tracking).
cash-secured puts (options_execution.py): Positions in the Book; since 2026-11-20 the Orders panel's 'Order history' shows each price-ladder step (see orders).
scale-in by thirds, cash reserve, capita: visible as decisions in the journal; no state view (how much reserve, what is queued)
LightGBM model (ml_model_v2.py): model status and Brain page; input held neutral in the score (#1660)
